entities.summary: Jacob "Jac" Nellemann is a former racing driver from Denmark. Reaching Formula One in 1976, his single entry was at the 1976 Swedish Grand Prix, driving Brabhams run by the small RAM team. Despite taking part in qualifying sessions in two cars, a BT42 and a BT44B, he failed to qualify. He was on the entry list for the following year's race, but he was not present for qualifying. Jac Nellemann was a architects & engineers from Copenhagen (b. 1944-04-19, Copenhagen). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
